notes.title: SEEING RED PLAYTEST RERUN
notes.content:
This build fixes all the sounds for the player in the water.
Changes the Interact to one key. 
Fixes some performances issues.

notes.title: Fix load order floor under savepoints
notes.content: fixed an issue in the cave where the floor under two of the spawn points was loading in the incorrect order leading players to fall through the map when they spawned on the save point.

notes.title: PLAYTEST LAUNCH
notes.content:
It’s that time of year when the veil between worlds is thin, and just in time for Friday the 13th, we’ve got something truly spine-chilling for you. The Lyterian Games team has been brewing something special in the shadows all year, and now it’s ready to emerge.

Join us for the official Playtest Launch of our upcoming game! We’ve worked hard to make this a truly immersive, heart-pounding experience, and we want you to be a part of it.

🔪 What to Expect:

🎮 Exclusive Playtest Access – Be among the first to dive into the world of Lyterian Games.
📰 Sign Up for Our Newsletter – Stay informed on all the latest horrors lurking just around the corner.
🌐 Visit Our New Website – Explore deeper into the mystery of our upcoming release.
🎉 Join Our Community – Connect with fellow players, give feedback, and help shape the future of the game.
Will you survive the Playtest? 🕯️💀 There’s only one way to find out…

Don’t miss out. The darkness awaits... on Steam.
